status: measurement set, not an exit test
note: WO-022. Each row of the envelope's height and wind table, on the X650 proxy at its nominal, half and double drag. The loss comes at about 32 m out: the 30 m flight box plus the 2 m position error. Results are simulation results, with uniform wind and an unvalidated ground contact.

cases.title: Position lost at about 32 m, 2.5 m/s, flying downwind: 5 m/s wind at 10 m (gz_x650_proxy)
cases.configured: Measure the reach from Home to the end of the ground slide. The fence does not act once position is lost; the gate's response is off, as in G-04.
